hero.title: At PublicidadActiva, We're Your Creative Ally
hero.subtitle: Design and Visual Communication Studio
hero.description: A multidisciplinary team focused on graphic design and content strategies that build genuine bonds between your brand and its audience. Here we don't just craft visuals: we tell stories that stay in people's memory and strengthen your customers' trust.

uxResearch.title: UX Research
uxResearch.description: We dig deep into how people think and behave when using your digital products, so we can refine every screen and deliver clear, comfortable and satisfying journeys.

brandIdentity.title: Brand Identity
brandIdentity.description: We shape and refresh your brand's image so it clearly conveys what it stands for, leaving a strong and lasting impression on everyone who sees it.

webDevelopment.title: Web Development
webDevelopment.description: We build carefully crafted websites — attractive and functional — that reflect your brand's professionalism and offer a smooth experience on any device.

businessStrategy.title: Business Strategy
businessStrategy.description: We support your business with strategic advice that connects your commercial goals with design and content, driving steady growth and renewal.

webDesign.title: Web Design
webDesign.description: We design pages that not only look good but also perform: they improve the visitor experience and help turn more opportunities into customers.

photography.title: Photography
photography.description: We capture your products and services with high-quality images that reinforce your visual identity and work on every platform where you're present.

ideas.title: We Imagine Differently. We Solve with Judgment.
ideas.description: At PublicidadActiva we stand out for turning complex challenges into creative and functional answers. Our commitment to innovation and well-done work has been key to the sustained success of those who trust us.

whyDifferent.title: Why Do We Stand Out?
whyDifferent.description: At PublicidadActiva we see design as something that goes beyond looks. Every project is a chance to create a unique emotional bond, turning ideas into experiences that communicate and captivate.

points.stories: Stories That Connect: every design we make tells a story crafted to speak to your audience.
points.strategies: Tailored Approaches: we know no two brands are alike. That's why we adapt each solution to your specific goals.
points.results: Visible Results: beyond design, we deliver measurable impact that drives growth and brand preference.

latestDesigns.title: Recent Projects
latestDesigns.description: At PublicidadActiva every piece of work is a chance to explore new ideas and reaffirm our commitment to quality. Take a look at some of the projects we've recently completed and see how we help brands stand out:

skills.title: Our Capabilities
skills.description: At PublicidadActiva we turn our passion for design into visual solutions that capture and express the essence of your brand. Here's how we put it into practice:
skills.branding: Branding: we develop memorable identities that speak to your audience and last over time.
skills.interfaces: Interface Design: we create clean, intuitive and functional screens that improve the experience and the product's overall performance.
skills.webDev: Web Development: we build sites that not only look great but also run flawlessly, adapted to all kinds of devices and browsers.

home.fusion: At PublicidadActiva we blend art and strategy to shape visual projects that attract and, at the same time, create an emotional connection with those who see them.

awarded.title: Award-Winning Design by PublicidadActiva
awarded.description: At PublicidadActiva, our commitment to doing things well has earned us several recognitions within the design world. Our approach seeks to unite the aesthetic with the functional to create visual solutions that grab attention, tell stories and strengthen brands.
awarded.product: Product Design: our product proposals stand out for their visual appeal, their usefulness and their adaptation to what the market demands today.
awarded.branding: Brand Identity: we create identities that reflect your company's spirit, making sure every element communicates your vision and values consistently.
